verdict.rationale: SvelteKit docs say route pages are server-rendered, and a community user reports a clear split between what loads on the server and what loads on the client. That suggests server-side data loading feeding into interactive pages. Nothing in the pack documents async server-rendered components or explicitly passing fetched data down to interactive client components. missing for 10: documentation of async/awaited data fetching inside server-rendered components, a documented mechanism for passing server-fetched data to interactive client components, hydration/serialization details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch data in asynchronous server-rendered components and pass it down to interactive client components

citations.quote: These will be server-rendered so that a user's first visit to your app is as fast as possible
It is now very clear in what order items load and what loads on the server vs the client.
